groups.title: Business & Market Analysis
groups.provides: Product definition (vision, scope, personas, Jobs-to-be-Done) plus market, competitor and positioning analysis
groups.skip_impact: No market validation or positioning; later design/architecture stages lose business context
groups.reason: Discovery/ideation mention: persona, target user, product definition

groups.title: Monetization & Pricing
groups.provides: Revenue model, pricing/packaging and unit economics (cost per user, margins, break-even)
groups.skip_impact: No pricing or unit-economics output (fine for non-commercial products)
groups.reason: no requirement signal found in discovery/ideation

groups.title: Go-to-Market & Customer Journey
groups.provides: Launch plan, channels, customer journey and marketing strategy

groups.title: Operations & Observability
groups.provides: Production operations: monitoring, SLAs, incidents, uptime and runbooks

groups.title: Customer Success & Support
groups.provides: Onboarding flows, support processes and customer-success playbooks

groups.title: Growth, Engagement & Feedback
groups.provides: Retention/growth loops, engagement and feedback capture
groups.reason: no requirement signal found in discovery/ideation

groups.title: Legal, Privacy & Compliance
groups.provides: Data handling/privacy, compliance review, plus security and accessibility audit
groups.skip_impact: Compliance/legal risk; strongly recommended if the product handles personal data
